mappings.reason: ADRs 0028/0095: complete copied-key resource caches execute on the active retained GPU device, with content comparison, compute/graphics/multipass/MSAA/multiview consumers, automatic dependency retirement, explicit-free eviction and independent session lifetime. Local-device, absent/Compatibility, owner/list and invalid-description guards reject. Prepared cache pairs and native frames require their recorded managed-allocation receipts; native heap, large-cache/free workloads and foreign targets remain separate gates. See docs/components/device-resource-caches.md.
